text_block_list.text:
Heading toward the Japan Derby, Gold City 
was brimming with energy. Her training was 
also on an upward trend—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer, how did it go!?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Alright!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, I'm really getting into top shape, 
aren't I? Not to toot my own horn or 
anything.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
If I manage to become a Derby Umamusume... 
...then you'd be a Derby Trainer, huh.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Well, that might be a bit of an 
exaggeration, right? But that's not really 
what I meant.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Running in the Derby still doesn't feel 
real to me at all, you know?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"I was determined to run, but I hadn't 
really thought about what kind of race I 
wanted to be in."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"Racking up GⅠ wins like it was nothing... 
Looking back, that was super vague of me."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"And that same me is running in the Derby? 
Hilarious."

Gold City's mood is on the rise as well. 
Just as I was thinking of carrying this 
momentum into the Derby—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Yo, City♪ I'm he~re☆

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Jordan? What, did you come here just to 
get in my way?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Isn't that, like, totally cold~?! I'm 
literally crying right now!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
You've been ignoring my messages, too. 
Thanks to that, I'm literally so bored~.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Why don't you do some training too, then?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"There's City's stoic side. It's great to 
be fired up, but don't go getting hurt, 
okay~?"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Especially after what happened with 
Tamamo-paisen and all, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...? Tamamo-senpai, did something happen?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
You don't know? Come on, you know, she got 
caught up in a tussle during the race.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I saw you running along the riverbank 
earlier, and you looked like you were in 
agony. It was painful just watching.

After training. Since Gold City was 
concerned, I went to check on Tamamo Cross 
at the riverbank—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Hah... Hah... Ngh...!!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Damn it, it won't move properly...!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Are you all right?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Kh, City.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hah... Did ya come to see me look like 
this? I'm totally beaten up, ain't I...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: No, that's not it! I...!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"...Sorry, I know. I just can't. I don't 
got any room to breathe right now..."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
If only I were stronger, much stronger... 
That wouldn't have happened...!

She had been buried in the pack and caught 
in a tumble during her recent race. She 
fell as well and was taking time off to 
recover from her bruises.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...I really come up short in every way. My 
body, my strength... everything needed to 
win, I don't have any of it.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: But, Senpai...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
It's fine. Facts are facts. No matter how 
much you lament reality, it won't change. 
But...!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
“—If it's not there, I'll seize it by 
force. I'll run as many times as it takes 
until I win...!”

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I don't need anything except victory! No 
matter how reckless it is, I'll keep 
challenging it!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
So what if I'm poor, so what if I'm 
small?! I'll crush it all with these legs 
of mine...!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"...So worrying about me is pointless. 
Especially against you, I can't afford to 
lose."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Me?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I saw the Satsuki Sho. Everyone around you 
was totally spooked by ya.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
You've already accomplished your goal of 
making them acknowledge you. I'm gonna do 
it too... I gotta win.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm headin' back to training. This is 
where we both gotta dig deep, so let's 
give it our all!"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Tamamo-senpai is really amazing.
choice_data_list: She's a strong-willed girl, isn't she.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. ...Nothing short of victory matters, 
huh?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
If she shows up... I wonder if I can 
really win.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...She's totally the type who thinks vibes 
and hype can solve anything, for real.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...I'm going back to training. Practice is 
way more trustworthy than you, anyway.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I have to show Senpai that I can win the 
Derby...!
